name: Plan
notes: Agree what you are building; who does what and how much it can cost.

name: Build
notes: Design and make the first working version.

name: Test and prepare
notes: Fix problems and get everything ready to share.

name: Launch
notes: Release it and learn from the first two weeks.

name: Define goals and scope
notes: Write down what success looks like and what is not included.

name: Set budget and team
notes: Confirm who is involved and how much time and money you have.

name: Write the project brief
notes: One page that everyone can read and agree to.

name: Project approved
notes: The decision-maker says go.

name: Talk to future users
notes: Learn what people actually need before drawing anything.

name: Sketch the screens
notes: Rough drawings are fine. Share early.

name: Build a clickable prototype
notes: Something people can tap through to give feedback.

name: Design signed off
notes: No more big design changes after this date.

name: Set up tools and accounts
notes: Code storage; shared folders; anything the team needs to work together.

name: Build the core features
notes: The must-haves only. Nice-to-haves wait.

name: Features complete
notes: Everything planned is built; even if rough.

name: Find and fix problems
notes: Test; list what is broken; fix the most important first.

name: Write the main message
notes: One clear sentence about what it is and who it is for.

name: Prepare launch materials
notes: Announcement text; images and a short guide.

name: Line up early users
notes: Ask a small group to try it first and tell you what they think.

name: Final checks
notes: Walk through the checklist one last time.

name: Go or no-go decision
notes: Decide together whether it is ready.

name: Launch day
notes: Release it.

name: Review how it went
notes: What worked; what did not; what to do next.
